ideas.name: Attic Hatch Seal Kit
ideas.concept: Pre-cut EPDM/foam gasket plus compression latches for loft hatches, sized to Nordic standard hatch dimensions, sold as a kit with fit guide.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic homeowners with attic hatches, DIY energy savers
ideas.problem_solved: Warm air leaks and condensation at attic hatch
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: web search and Firecrawl were unavailable (budget/credits exhausted), so no trend signal was checked. Based on general energy-saving DIY interest only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Nordic hatch-size SKUs, installation guidance, bundle exclusivity with supplier die-cut profiles

ideas.name: Window Frame Condensation Wick Strips
ideas.concept: Self-adhesive absorbent channel strips for window sills with replaceable inserts and refill packs.
ideas.target_customer: Renters and homeowners in older Nordic houses
ideas.problem_solved: Winter window sill condensation and mould-prone frames (non-medical)
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search could be run; demand assumption from seasonal condensation pain only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Refill subscription, sill-profile fit by window type (ex-VELUX knowledge)

ideas.name: Roof-Window Blind Spare Parts Kit
ideas.concept: Universal replacement cords, clips and side-rail glides for common roof-window blinds, sold by model compatibility.
ideas.problem_solved: Broken blind parts with expensive OEM replacement
ideas.trend_evidence: UNVERIFIED: no search run; repair-over-replace regulation direction in EU is background knowledge, not checked.

ideas.name: Draught Tape Tuner Set
ideas.concept: Window and door seal kit with different profile thicknesses, a gap-measuring gauge card and cutting guide to choose right size.
ideas.problem_solved: Wrong seal size and poor fit from generic tapes
ideas.defensibility_angle: Gauge-plus-kit system and branding, sizing guidance content

ideas.name: Attic Storage Floor Marker and Load Tags
ideas.concept: Reusable joist markers and weight-limit tags so users store safely on non-boarded attic floors.
ideas.problem_solved: Stepping through ceilings, unclear safe zones
ideas.defensibility_angle: Safety branding and certified-looking guidance; low copy motivation
